subject: Post-discovery: pick 30-min briefing slot and confirm stakeholders
messages:
From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@greenridgehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@greenridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Greenridge x Redwood — follow-up & demo request

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the discovery conversation this morning — it was really helpful to understand how Redwood could help us reduce inference cost and improve latency for our care-coordination ML services. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goals: lower cost per inference, predictable p95 latency, and secure private deployment options for PHI-sensitive flows.
- Key stakeholders: ML infra (Sam), Security & Compliance (I'll loop in procurement/security once timing is firm), and a product sponsor (me).

Can we move to a 30-minute product briefing/demo where you can show: the runtime behavior for streaming chat, routing/fallback examples, and a short ops/observability walkthrough (console dashboards)? We want to include Sam (infra) and one security contact if possible.

Our availability next week is a bit tight — can you propose 2–3 concrete time windows (include timezone) and who from your side will attend? Also, please attach any concise M.A.P. or preparatory checklist you prefer we review.

Appreciate it,
Alex

Alex Barnes
Director, Applied ML
Greenridge Health
alex.barnes@greenridgehealth.com
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@greenridgehealth.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@greenridgehealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T11:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Greenridge x Redwood — follow-up & demo request

Alex — thanks for the clear recap and for outlining stakeholders. Glad the discovery was useful.

Proposed 30-minute windows (PST):
1) Tue 2026-11-09 10:00–10:30 PT
2) Tue 2026-11-09 15:00–15:30 PT
3) Wed 2026-11-10 08:30–09:00 PT

If none of those work, we can offer Wed 11/10 16:00–16:30 PT as a fallback.

From our side I'd plan to have:
- Stephanie Nguyen — Sales lead & short business context (me)
- Vivek Kulkarni — Product/Infra (will demo runtime + KV-caching examples)
- Monica Patel — Solutions Engineer (observability, rollout/ops best practices)

Attached: concise mutual-action-plan (one-pager) to frame the briefing and a short prep checklist. If procurement/security will join, please copy them on the time you pick so we can attach the appropriate security artifacts (SOC2 summary, data flows).

Agenda (30m):
- 5m quick context (your goals & constraints)
- 15m demo (runtime, routing, streaming)
- 5m ops/observability & next steps
- 5m Q&A / procurement asks

Next steps: choose one of the three preferred slots and confirm security/procurement attendee (name + email).

Cheers,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.pdf (1 page, overview)
From: Alex Barnes <alex.barnes@greenridgehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@greenridgehealth.com>, Greenridge Health Procurement <procurement@greenridgehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Greenridge x Redwood — follow-up & demo request

Thanks, Stephanie — those slots look good. We can do option 2: Tue 2026-11-09 15:00–15:30 PT.

I'll have Sam (infra) join, and I'm looping procurement/security (procurement@greenridgehealth.com) for visibility — they may send a security point if they can.

Quick asks before the demo:
- Can you include a 1-slide summary of your private deployment / VPC model and KMS integrations (we'll want to share with security ahead of time)?
- If you could attach the SOC2 overview and brief note on data retention policies that'd be great.

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-03T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Confirming Tue 11/09 15:00 PT — calendar invite + prep materials

Hi Alex / team — thanks for confirming. Calendar invite is sent for Tue 2026-11-09 15:00–15:30 PT (30m). Please accept when convenient.

Prep materials attached:
- mutual-action-plan.pdf (sent earlier)
- security-questions.xlsx (simple checklist for security/procurement to pre-fill)
- 1-slide VPC/KMS summary (will be included in the invite as a slide preview)

Draft invite attendees from Redwood: Stephanie (AE), Vivek (Product), Monica (Solutions). From Greenridge: Alex (product sponsor), Sam (infra), plus procurement/security as CC'd. If you want any specific logs/metrics examples in the demo (p95 traces, token-cost breakdown), let us know and we can surface them.

Agenda in the invite is aligned with your ask; after the demo we'll propose a short mutual-action plan with success criteria and next steps (pilot scope).

Thanks — see you Tuesday.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
Attachments: security-questions.xlsx; vpc-kms-onepager.pdf
